source.extraction: manual transcription of the prose table into data; no number was recomputed, rounded or reinterpreted during extraction

confidence.statement: SELF-ASSESSED UPPER BOUND, NOT A MEASUREMENT. The 'covered' column was scored by each of the five curriculum-mapping areas about its own work. The source report (section 0 and section 5.5) documents at least one proven false positive in that column: NICE DD-WRL-005 (product end-of-life) was declared covered by SUP-02/SUP-13/SUP-14, and SUP-02 in fact measures distance to the latest version, which is a different question. Every 'covered' count is therefore an over-count of unknown size, and every pcc value is a ceiling.

known_false_positives.resolution: not covered; SUP-02 measures distance to latest version, not support status of the branch. Backlog item SUP-24.

confidence.denominator_caveat: The unit 'topic' is not homogeneous across curricula: PortSwigger enumerates by exploitable class (fine grain), cloud exam guides by objective (coarse grain). This inflates the web-api denominator and deflates the infra-cloud one, so infra-cloud is probably worse than 40%, not better.
confidence.excluded_from_denominator: Everything the five areas classified as out of audit scope (weaponisation, evasion, GRC, introductory theory, SOC operations) was removed from the denominator by explicit, traceable decision. PCC measures coverage of what this project decided to audit, not of everything a syllabus teaches.

packs.sample_note: n=8 topics. Too small a sample to conclude anything; the source report calls it an anecdote, not a measurement. Reported, never used as a trend.

_why: Packs that exist in the corpus and carry NO score here, with the reason, because the alternative is worse.
This file is a transcription: its own `source` block says no number was recomputed, rounded or reinterpreted
during extraction. Inventing a row for a pack the source document never scored would break exactly that
guarantee, and a self-assessed number invented later is not comparable to the seven that were transcribed.
So the pack is named here instead. The meter treats a pack listed below as a DECLARED gap and a pack in
neither list as drift - the same distinction `engagement.coverage` draws between not-read and silence.

packs.reason: The pack was added to the corpus after the source report of 2026-08-16, which scored seven packs and did not see this one. Scoring it needs the same curriculum mapping the other seven got, against the four `mapa-*.md` documents, and that work has not been done.
packs.what_would_settle_it: A curriculum mapping of LOC-01..LOC-15 against docs/coverage/mapa-certs.md, mapa-microsoft.md, mapa-openssf.md and mapa-ia-movil.md, recorded in a dated block separate from the transcribed seven so the two provenances are never averaged.
